page.overview:
Who is Ham Ghao?

Ham Ghao joined the other Sun Warriors in bowing to Ran and Shaw, eagerly awaiting the masters' killing of Aang and Zuko, for which the chief chastised him. Upon witnessing the masters' acceptance of the two, Ham Ghao cast a frustrated look off to the side, yet was just as quick to accept their worth and trust.
